findings.evidence: Every relevant statement uses `mapValue φ`; meanwhile `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/CFSGStatement/Suggested.lean:390-395` defines graph branches as `graphAut.comp frobenius` and exceptional branches as odd powers of `halfFrobenius`, all as endomorphisms of `AmbientGroup`.
findings.fix: Describe these as value-algebra/scalar endomorphisms, restrict the `G(𝔽_q)` discussion to untwisted Frobenius, and remove or explicitly qualify the general Steinberg and Suzuki–Ree claims.
findings.issue: The module docstring, `fixedPointsEquiv` docstring (lines 223–227), and square lemma docstring (lines 260–262) misleadingly identify `φ : A →ₐ[R] A` with a Steinberg endomorphism and suggest applicability to Suzuki–Ree maps. The results only concern point maps induced by scalar post-composition.

summary: The documentation repeatedly presents scalar-induced point maps as covering general Steinberg endomorphisms, although graph-twisted and Suzuki–Ree maps are endomorphisms of the ambient group, not merely post-composition by value-algebra endomorphisms.
